setting.help: Stored Fernet-encrypted via ir.config_parameter (IRIS_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Required for screening, guide and scorecard generation.
Any OpenRouter chat-completions model id, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5, moonshotai/kimi-k2, google/gemini-2.5-pro.
Chat-completions endpoint base. Default is OpenRouter; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.
Per-request timeout for LLM calls.
Retries on retryable HTTP errors (429/5xx) before the job is marked failed.
Fallback cost rate when the provider response does not include billed cost.
HOLD candidates without verification evidence are auto-blocked this many business days (Mon-Fri) after the first HOLD verdict.
v1.1 ships with the seeded Head of Engineering role only. Tick to unlock creating additional role profiles — one config flip, no code change.
Maximum candidates per screening batch. Caps the token budget of the LLM batch-consistency pass.
Near-duplicate resume ratio (0-1). Resumes at or above this similarity are flagged as possible duplicates. Advisory only — never blocks an upload, never touches state.
How many of the most recent resumes each upload is compared against in the near-duplicate scan (0 disables the near-duplicate scan; exact-hash matching always runs).
Which s3.connector to use for private resume PDF storage (presigned GET). Leave empty to keep resumes as Odoo attachments only.
